title: deferred-work.md records a 'remaining staleness' in apply-form-label-invariants that does not exist — the scenario already ticks consent before the empty-submit click
evidence:
deferred-work.md:552: "Remaining pre-existing staleness (unowned): apply-form-label-invariants' empty-submit step clicks a consent-disabled submit button (needs force_submit or consent tick)." — but .claude/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/landing/apply-form-label-invariants.yaml:345-361 reads: `- action: javascript
    description: "Check consent checkbox (fires change event to enable submit via form.js)"
    code: |
      const consent = document.querySelector('[data-testid="gdpr-consent-checkbox"]');
      ...
      consent.click();` followed by `- action: click
    selector: '[data-testid="submit-application"]'
    description: "Submit form with required fields empty"`
detail: The entry logs an unowned bug as still present, but the scenario's consent-tick JS step (present since PR #76, commit 62bc936) enables submit via form.js's change listener before the empty-submit click. A future dev would hunt a non-existent bug.
recommended_fix: Strike the 'Remaining pre-existing staleness' sentence from the entry, or rewrite it to record that the consent tick already covers the empty-submit click.
